title: M6 / EDGE-001 Tsunami prospective design cross-examination
question: After the July native mechanism decomposition and prospective owner binding, is EDGE-001's current prospective feature-collection design scientifically sufficient, what should be killed or repaired before any information-edge scoring, and what is the cheapest decisive prospective falsification path?
hypothesis: The framework may contain useful early deterioration information, but current evidence only justifies pre-outcome continuous feature collection on natural M6 warnings; binary A0-A3 scoring should remain blocked until legitimate portable owner semantics exist.
baseline: M6 warning-event outcome owner plus HOLD/price-only comparators; no July-specific threshold transfer and no noncanonical breadth substitution.
falsifier: If current feature capture leaks future information, silently substitutes noncanonical owners, cannot bind legal knowledge time, or cannot support a future same-opportunity comparison, reject or repair it before collection/scoring.
kill_condition: If no portable point-in-time feature set can be frozen without outcome-derived thresholds or owner substitution, keep EDGE-001 at hypothesis and collect only the primary M6 outcome stream.
